name: statsmodels
purpose: Statistical models and econometrics in Python: linear and generalised regression, time series, panel data and statistical tests, with full result tables.
version_guidance: Install the latest release that supports your Python version. Record the version: model output and defaults can change between releases.

windows.text: Open a terminal in your project folder and activate your virtual environment first.

macos.text: Open a terminal in your project folder and activate your virtual environment first.

linux.text: Open a terminal in your project folder and activate your virtual environment first.

windows.expected: One line: statsmodels and its version, for example statsmodels 1.x.y.

macos.expected: One line: statsmodels and its version, for example statsmodels 1.x.y.

linux.expected: One line: statsmodels and its version, for example statsmodels 1.x.y.

common_problems.solution: Your virtual environment is probably not active, or the package went into another Python. Activate the environment, then install again with python -m pip install.

common_problems.problem: pip says it cannot find a version that satisfies the requirement
common_problems.solution: Your Python may be too old or too new for the latest release. Check your Python version with python --version and the supported versions on the official installation page.

manual_review: The install command is the official pip command, run as python -m pip.
The verification command prints a label before the version, so another library cannot pass the check.
